transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. It's nice to meet you. Could you tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Hi, Dr. Smith. Nice to meet you too. I came in today because... well, I've had this really drastic shift recently. I went from going absolutely non-stop at work—launching all these plant redesign projects, calling our suppliers way after hours, and rewriting the entire shift plan all by myself—to suddenly just... crashing. Now I'm completely unable to keep up with the very plans I just set in motion, and it's really becoming a problem.
Have you ever had periods like the one you described—where you felt an intense, non-stop burst of energy and activity—at any point in your life prior to this recent experience?

Yeah, I have. Um, there was a stretch a while back where I just had this massive surplus of energy. I remember I was unpacking boxes well after midnight, completely reorganizing my apartment, and then I'd sit down and answer a bunch of work emails. And even after doing all of that, I still felt wide awake and actually wanted to drive back to the plant just to check on one more thing. It was just a very intense drive to keep doing things.

During those periods where you had that massive surplus of energy, did you ever feel like you were seeing or hearing things that others couldn't, or did you have any beliefs that seemed unusual or out of touch with reality?

No, um... no, nothing like that. I've never seen or heard anything that wasn't there. And my ideas weren't really out of touch with reality, I just... I just had a lot of them all at once. I was completely aware of what was going on around me and knew what was real, I was just moving and thinking a lot faster than normal.
During this current period where you feel unable to keep up, have you been feeling deeply sad, hopeless, or like you have lost interest in things you usually enjoy?

Yeah, I have. Lately, I just wake up in my temporary apartment with this... really heavy, hollow feeling. It's like the day is already ruined before I even get out of bed to drive to the plant. I just feel incredibly sad and empty.
During this current period of feeling sad and empty, have you had any thoughts that life is not worth living or that you would be better off dead?

No, I haven't. I mean, I feel miserable and just... completely drained, but I haven't had any thoughts about wanting to die or anything like that. I just want this heavy feeling to go away so I can get back to normal.
During this current period of feeling sad and drained, have you found yourself unable to function at work or take care of your basic personal needs, like showering or eating?

Yeah, it's definitely affecting my work. I actually... I had to ask to be pulled out of a shift-planning meeting recently. Occupational health ended up getting involved because I just wasn't able to carry out the basic production decisions that my entire role depends on. I just can't seem to function there right now.
During this period where you've felt unable to function at work, have you experienced a complete loss of interest or pleasure in nearly all of your daily activities?

Yeah, I'd say so. I just... I don't care about anything right now. Usually, I'd at least try to read or, I don't know, watch a show when I get back to the apartment, but I just don't have the energy or the desire to do any of it. Nothing feels enjoyable anymore. I just kind of sit there.

During this time that you have felt so drained and unable to function, have you noticed that your movements or your speech have become noticeably slowed down to the point where others might have commented on it?

Yeah, people have definitely noticed. It's actually kind of both extremes. Sometimes I'm moving painfully slowly, like... it feels like it takes a huge amount of effort just to pick up a binder off my desk. But then other times, sitting still just feels completely unbearable. During those times I end up just pacing around the production office and picking at my nails. So yeah, my coworkers have definitely seen it.
How long have you been feeling this way—this deep sadness and loss of interest—without any break in these symptoms?

It's been... about three months now. This heavy, depressed feeling just hasn't lifted at all during that time. I recently had to move and take on a new plant assignment, and honestly, that's just made it all much harder to manage. But yeah, it's been a solid three months of feeling like this.
